notes.title: About The Future Of The Game
notes.content:
As the Hexen Hegemony team, we had been shut down for a long time because we were dealing with financial problems. We apologize to anyone who has shown interest in our game for this unfortunate situation. As a result of our efforts to create new opportunities, we have reached a point where we can resume our game and get the necessary help.

After the introduction of the game in May at the latest "Free to Play" (Free To Play) will re-air. We will only provide "Turkish" language support for a while. With the new updates we're working on, you'll find a Hexen Hegemony with more dynamic and varied content.

We have thought of a number of solutions to eliminate the grievance that has arisen in the last few months. When the game is changed to F2P model, it is possible to refund the players who have paid in Turkish Liras or to evaluate this payment in the new game period. Players requesting a refund must be contacted via the @hexen.tr Instagram page to provide us with their SteamID and IBAN numbers. Players who want their payments to be evaluated in the new game period and added to their user accounts in the form of Altın Golden Coins ası are required to submit a DM to the same Instagram page and submit their SteamID.

In the new era, we will come up with a game that gives more importance to promotion and player interaction, can reach larger audiences and everyone can play as much as they want for free. Unlike most free games, Hexen Hegemony will never adopt "Pay To Win" as a policy. We want you to know that we are as sensitive as our players.

We aim to create a value by repeating our old mistakes and continuing our way with our experience. We would like to express our love and respect to our small audience who are interested in Hexen Hegemony...
